_readme: HAND-ENTERED UPCOMING MATCHES. OpenDota has no schedule endpoint — there is no way to
fetch future match times, so this file is the only source for them.
startUtc MUST be UTC ISO 8601 ending in Z. Never put a local time here.
10:00 AM Aug 15 in Shanghai = 2026-08-15T02:00:00Z  (= Fri Aug 14, 10:00 PM EDT)
05:00 PM Aug 15 in Shanghai = 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z  (= Fri Aug 15, 05:00 AM EDT)
Leave aTeamId / bTeamId out (or null) when the matchup is not known yet; the card
renders as TBD and still shows the time. Use aLabel / bLabel for things like
Once a match is actually played, OpenDota takes over automatically and its entry here
is ignored — completed data always beats this file. You can leave old rows in place.
DELETE the placeholder row below once you enter real matches.
